comment: An unrealised reference element is automatically treated as a gap. A country may intentionally meet the underlying capability through an alternative design or determine that the capability is not currently applicable.

anchor.note: p.86 l.Lines 1221-1222 read as the printed page; section 3.7.5 agrees

public.text: An unrealised reference element is automatically treated as a gap. A country may intentionally meet the underlying capability through an alternative design or determine that the capability is not currently applicable.
public.suggestedRevision: Classify uncovered elements as confirmed gap, alternative realisation, deferred, not applicable, or intentionally excluded. Require rationale, risk assessment, and approval for non-gap classifications.
